s.zh: DND边缘大陆：十二个 DND 职业（战士、圣武士、武僧、法师、牧师、德鲁伊、术士、野蛮人、游侠、游荡者、邪术师、吟游诗人）不再需要 VPE，改成冒险者的职业等级。每个冒险者等级给 1 点职业点（最多 20），可以分给最多 3 个职业。\n\n
s.en: DND Rimlands: the twelve DND classes (fighter, paladin, monk, wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, barbarian, ranger, rogue, warlock, bard) no longer need VPE and are now adventurer class levels. Each adventurer level gives 1 class point (max 20), which can be split among up to 3 classes.\n\n

s.zh: \n\n选中殖民者点“选择职业”按钮，或在“冒险者”分页的“职业”页里加点。
s.en: \n\nSelect a colonist and click the "choose class" button, or add points on the "Class" page of the "Adventurer" tab.

s.en: Lists abilities and spells gained at each class level: gained ones are highlighted, not-yet-gained ones are greyed with the required level. Hover for the full description.

s.zh: 施法类能力受心灵敏感度影响
s.en: Spellcasting abilities affected by psychic sensitivity

s.zh: 1.72.0 职业：武僧的气功（拨挡箭矢、震慑拳、金刚之躯、颤心掌、空灵之身）和圣武士的神术（至圣斩、圣疗、神圣武器、放逐邪恶、圣光化身）的伤害、治疗再乘心灵敏感度（最低 ×0.2，不封顶）。战士的战技永远不乘。
s.en: 1.72.0 classes: damage and healing of the monk's ki techniques (deflect missiles, stunning strike, diamond soul, quivering palm, empty body) and the paladin's divine arts (divine smite, lay on hands, sacred weapon, banish evil, holy avatar) are also multiplied by psychic sensitivity (minimum ×0.2, uncapped). Fighter maneuvers are never multiplied.

s.zh: 1.72.0 职业：打开时，有心灵链接的人施放职业能力另外增加心灵熵（每 1 点资源消耗 +5）。默认关闭：职业能力只消耗斗志 / 气 / 神恩。
s.en: 1.72.0 classes: when on, people with a psylink casting class abilities also gain neural heat (+5 per resource point spent). Off by default: class abilities only cost fighting spirit / ki / divine favor.
